strings.text: Many of the fishermen made fun of the old man, and he was not angry.
strings.translation: Muchos de los pescadores se burlaban del viejo, y él no se enojaba.

strings.text: I could go with you again. We've made money.
strings.translation: Podría volver a salir contigo. Hemos ganado dinero.

strings.text: No. You're with a lucky boat. Stay with them.
strings.translation: No. Estás en un bote con suerte. Quédate con ellos.
